question_2.text: Which message contains the clearest phishing red flag?
choices: A. "Your monthly school newsletter is available."
B. "Your account will be deleted in 10 minutes—click now!"
C. "Your package is expected to arrive tomorrow."
D. "Your teacher posted a new assignment."

question_3.text: What should you do when a message says your account has been suspended?
choices: A. Click the link and enter your password
B. Reply and ask whether the message is real
C. Open the official app or website yourself and check
D. Forward the message to your friends

question_4.text: What should you do if you already clicked a suspicious link?
choices: A. Ignore it and hope nothing happens
B. Tell a trusted adult immediately
C. Click it again to check what it was
